description: This file contains a script for converting a quote into an invoice within the SuiteCRM system. It retrieves a quote record, updates its status, creates a new invoice, copies related data and line items from the quote to the invoice, and sets up relationships between the invoice and quote.

classes.name: ACLController

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating, retrieving, and populating bean objects corresponding to database records.
